synth.notes:
Single horizontal axis (wall band) + holed 3x3-block pieces; selection = 0-filled holes (axis / piece / none).
A1/A2 move selection by a block row, A3/A4 move a selected piece by a column (bounds + other pieces block; axis passes under pieces).
Missed mechanic at step 64: A5 cycles none/axis -> pieces in LARGEST-FIRST order (block count desc, tie bbox) -> axis, not bbox order (bbox fails only step 64).
Reflections: every piece block off the axis row -> (2A-r, c), clipped, skipped on piece blocks; layered render then re-extract; wall/piece names rank comps of own cells plus all 0 cells.
Open: largest-first vs nearest-axis-first both fit the data; merged unselected pieces cannot be split statelessly. Target A1 mixed outcome = reflection occlusion.
